method: GFN2-xTB/ALPB(water) Hessian (modified Seminario, calibrated to B3LYP-D3BJ/DZVP by chemical environment) and relaxed scans; GFN1-xTB CM5 charges in ALPB(water); capped ACE-X-NME, alpha and beta backbone conformers averaged; angle scales and torsion series force-matched to SPICE dipeptides (B3LYP-D3BJ/DZVP); planar sp2-sp2 torsions (amide, guanidinium, omega) from the calibrated library as -B/2 cos 2phi (calibrated barrier B), guanidinium C-N twins (fix_planar_torsions.py)
